# Adr 005 Oncall Rotation

ADR-005 sets one-week on-call rotations per team with a secondary from another team, following the [[oncall-runbook]]. Applies to [[team-payments]], [[team-identity]], [[team-discovery]] and [[team-platform]]. Handover happens Mondays 10:00 UTC-3.
